title: byelian - faded friends
htmlContent:
Singer and songwriter byelian coming from the deep west of Germany releases a new track called "faded friends" a song for everyone to relate. His single shocked a lot of musicians in the industry. The song features a very astounding flow and with the melodic lyrics, this song is perfect.

byelian's "faded friends" is a record that goes beyond being just nice to hear, but necessary listen for this major talent. He’s a sure fire star and it couldn’t be any more apparent than hearing his music. He excels in every aspect of his craft to make something that any one who presses play will love the energy of.
